definition: Encode each of the m symbols of u in two bits. Control v^(i) asks for bit i, and F(u,v^(i)) returns that bit.

model.type: one-layer SSM with singleton state and a constant binary output
model.success: For every distribution D over inputs, choose the more probable output label; success is at least 1/2.

contradiction: The imported positive linear-in-m interpretation cannot hold at the exact 1/2 threshold.
